title: The Sick child in the room
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：sick　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sick 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the grandmother wrote of ① a sick child in the room in the diary, and everybody in the courtyard said at once that it was ② sicker than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grandmother, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the sick ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the sickest child in the room anybody in the courtyard had ever seen, or so the diary for February 1948 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too sick to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the sick ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a sick smell from the kitchen, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as sick as the smell from the kitchen they had once had in the old courtyard. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was sick or not, and he said so.

By 1961 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the diary. What the line asked for was ⑦ something sick, and nothing besides. The child from the next courtyard called the whole plan ⑧ quite sick; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the diary kept the names of the sick ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1964, without complaint, she wrote of another sick child in the room in the same diary, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ sicker than anybody had expected. ⑩ The sickest smell from the kitchen in the whole courtyard, she said in 1966, was the one she could never quite name; the sick ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 生病（前置定语 a sick child in the room：1954 年祖母在日记里记下的那件生病的孩子）
B. adj. 生病／令人反胃（比较级 sicker than：文中两处，一处比屋里生病的孩子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 生病／令人反胃（最高级 the sickest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 生病（表语 too sick to do：母亲觉得它太生病，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 令人反胃（前置定语 a sick smell from the kitchen：叔叔把整件事称作一桩令人反胃的气味）
F. adj. 令人反胃（同级比较 as sick as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩厨房里让人反胃的气味相比）
G. adj. 令人反胃（后置定语 something sick：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 令人反胃（受程度副词修饰 quite sick：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a sick child in the room
the sickest child in the room anybody
a sick smell from the kitchen
The sickest smell from the kitchen in

answers.why: sick 意为“生病”，1954 年祖母在日记里记下的是“一件生病的孩子”，此处作前置定语 a sick child in the room。
sick 意为“生病”，此处用比较级 sicker than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
sick 意为“生病”，日记上 二月 那行字说它是院子里最生病的一件，故用最高级 the sickest child in the room。
sick 意为“生病”，母亲认为这件东西“太生病了，谁也用不上”，too sick to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
sick 意为“令人反胃”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩令人反胃的气味”，此处作前置定语 a sick smell from the kitchen。
sick 意为“令人反胃”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩厨房里让人反胃的气味一样令人反胃”，同级比较用 as sick as。
sick 意为“令人反胃”，日记上那半行字要的是“令人反胃的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something sick。
sick 意为“令人反胃”，邻院子来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当令人反胃”，quite 修饰原级 sick。
sick 意为“令人反胃”，1964 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要令人反胃”，故用比较级 sicker than。
sick 意为“令人反胃”，母亲 1966 年说的是“整个院子里最令人反胃的那一桩”，故用最高级 the sickest smell from the kitchen。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年，祖母在日记里记下了一件生病的孩子。（a sick child in the room）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更生病。（sicker than …）
母亲觉得它太生病，谁也用不上。（too sick to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩令人反胃的气味。（a sick smell from the kitchen）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩厨房里让人反胃的气味一样令人反胃。（as sick as …）
到了 1961 年，日记上只剩半行字：要的是一件令人反胃的东西。（something sick）
answers: In 1954 the grandmother wrote of a sick child in the room in the diary.
Everybody said it was sicker than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too sick to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a sick smell from the kitchen.
He said nobody would call it as sick as the smell from the kitchen they had once had.
By 1961 the diary asked for nothing but something sick.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sick 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the grandmother wrote of a sick child in the room in the diary, and nobody forgot it.
It was the sickest child in the room in the courtyard, or so the diary says.
My mother thought it too sick to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a sick smell from the kitchen, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next courtyard called the plan quite sick, and everybody laughed.
The sick ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
